title: 電路板邊界掃描測試
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究TAP 狀態、結構測試與覆蓋邊界；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate TAP states, structural tests and coverage limits. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設總掃描鏈 1,200 bit、TCK=5 MHz，一次移位約 240 µs；100 個向量純移位時間約 24 ms。
workedExample.textEn: For a 1,200-bit chain at 5 MHz TCK, one shift takes about 240 µs; 100 vectors require about 24 ms of shifting alone.
workedExample.assumptions: 忽略 TAP 切換和等待；時鐘速率必須受所有鏈上元件規格限制。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Excludes TAP transitions and waits; clock rate must satisfy every device in the chain.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

Boundary scan verifies controllable/observable connections, not complete functional behavior. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states.
